name: Light Shadow Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:

Crafted from premium 5mm thick wood, offering a sturdy structure with a smooth finish. The natural wooden texture adds warmth and elegance to any space.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Lantern dimensions (LxWxH): 4.5 x 4.5 x 4.5 inches ~ 11.43 x 11.43 x 11.43 cm.

Each panel is precision-cut with interlocking tabs and slots for easy self-assembly — no special tools required.

 

  • Printing Technology:

UV printing ensures vivid, clear, and sharp imagery. The product features double-sided printing for a beautiful look from every angle.

Precision laser-cut patterns project intricate shadows, creating a captivating lighting effect when illuminated.

 

  • Special Features:

Round base slot inside the lantern is designed to fit a tea light or LED candle (not included) securely in place, preventing movement and ensuring even light distribution.

When illuminated, the cut-out designs project vivid shadow patterns — paw prints, hearts, and your custom name — onto nearby walls and surfaces.

 

  • Functionality Use:

Ideal as a decorative lantern, night light, or ambient light piece. When lit, it projects charming paw prints, heart shapes, and custom text onto nearby walls, filling the room with a cozy and heartwarming glow. Perfect for personalizing with a pet's name or special message.

  • A Gift for Every Occasion:

A thoughtful and heart-touching gift suitable for pet lovers, friends, and family on any occasion — birthdays, anniversaries, Christmas, Valentine's Day, housewarmings, or as a memorial keepsake.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x3D Shadow Lantern 

 

PRODUCTION

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
